title: Hal warns of 33 million volts

tellings.quote: The how was telling me that they knew the voltage was like 33 million volts in one of these things.

plain: One of the objects seen in North Carolina carried around 33 million volts, and "they" knew it, according to a man named Hal Pavvenmeer, as Chris Bledsoe tells it. Bledsoe, who says he draws UFOs to him, recalls Hal telling him this around 2007, without saying who "they" were or how they measured it. If true, it would mean someone had measured the energy of these things and found it was dangerous.
